description: We are enthusiastic first-year EEE students passionate about space, astronomy and technology. We are participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 to explore innovative ideas and solve real-world challenges. We welcome motivated teammates interested in programming, electronics, web development, research and creative problem-solving. Beginners are welcome! Let's learn, collaborate and create something amazing together! 🚀
summary: Our project, developed by Team ElectraTech, is an interactive Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer designed to introduce children and young learners to the exciting world of space exploration. It provides a virtual training experience where users can learn about astronaut life, space missions, spacecraft, and the challenges of exploring space. Through engaging activities, mission-based tasks, and educational challenges, users can develop problem-solving, critical-thinking, and teamwork skills. The project aims to make space science simple, fun, and accessible while inspiring the next generation of astronauts, scientists, and space explorers.
